artifacts.summary: Seven-phase plan: convergence guard (identical-dispatch hashing, then halt+back-out) in orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh; corroboration-trigger widening with a corroboration-gated overwrite in orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh plus a comment-only skill-base.sh correction; the four gate verification arms; and the decision-gate documentation in plan-format.md/status-markers.md/handoff-schema.md. No new marker, no handoff-schema field, no defect-enum class.

memory_candidates.content: orchestrate-unwind-dispatch.sh is BY-HAND-ONLY by its own header contract ('never invoked automatically by the orchestrate loop'), so any in-loop guard in orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh that must abort a dispatch AFTER orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh has already run cannot delegate the back-out to it. The six side effects taken before the dispatch row is built are: task-dir mkdir, task-lock acquire, dispatch_seq mint (mt_state), forced-phase pop, skill_preflight_update status write, and the .dispatch/{seq}.md file. An inline back-out reverses them from the pre-image already captured in scope (_pd_prior_status/_pd_prior_last_updated/_pd_prior_session_id, captured immediately before skill_preflight_update) via state-write.sh --regen-todo, plus task-lock.sh release and deleting the dispatch file -- while simply SKIPPING the not-yet-taken budget charge, --flush-seq and pending_dispatch record.
